sector_model: Healthcare biopharma / plasma biologics (small-mid): earnings, FCF after capex, product concentration, inventory, leverage; GAAP and adjusted both shown
thesis: ADMA Biologics (Nasdaq: ADMA), plasma-derived immune globulins (ASCENIV, BIVIGAM). Q3 2026 release (8-K 0001140361-26-041959 Ex99.1, relevant sections read) and 10-Q 0001140361-26-041977 (statements and notes read; MD&A cut at 100,000 characters): revenue 141.1M vs 134.2M (+5.1%), 9M 380.0M vs 371.0M (+2.4%); ASCENIV 124.7M (+30.7%, 88% of Q3 revenue), BIVIGAM 15.4M (-35.2%), intermediates and other 0.9M vs 15.0M. Gross margin 71% vs 56%; net income 49.9M vs 36.4M (Q3), 133.0M 9M vs 97.6M; GAAP EPS 0.22; adjusted net income 51.1M, adjusted EBITDA 77.3M. 9M OCF 105.2M vs 14.8M, capex 6.8M. Guidance 2026: revenue at least 530M (reiterated), adjusted EBITDA at least 275M and adjusted net income at least 180M (both raised). Balance sheet 2026-09-30: cash 124.6M, debt 195.9M (JPM revolver 125.0M drawn in 2026, term loan 72.2M), inventories 266.1M, equity 438.5M; 16.5M shares repurchased in 9M (180.3M; 6.3% of shares), shares outstanding 222.8M (237.9M at Dec 2025), 221.85M at cover date 2026-10-30. Valuation: close 13.68 (2026-11-13) x 221,854,389 = market cap 3.03B; TTM GAAP net income 182.4M (146.9 + 133.0 - 97.6) = 16.6x; 16.9x adjusted net income guide floor 180M; TTM FCF 132.9M (OCF 140.8M less capex 7.9M) = 4.4% yield (3.6% after TTM SBC 24.1M); net debt 71.3M. Close rose from 10.48 (2026-11-04) to 13.21 (2026-11-05) after the print, +26%. Market view: a one-drug growth story with falling BIVIGAM; evidence for: ASCENIV +31%, margin expansion, buybacks, raised floors; evidence against: total growth slowed to 2.4% in 9M, three customers are about 86% of Q3 revenue.
counterthesis: Concentration and quality of growth: three customers were about 86% of Q3 revenue and two customers about 84% of receivables (10-Q), so one lost contract or distributor pricing change breaks the story. ASCENIV is 88% of Q3 revenue; BIVIGAM fell 47% over 9M to competitive pricing and channel inventory, and total 9M revenue grew only 2.4% while gross margin gains (yield enhancement, mix) drove earnings; margin gains are finite. Inventory is 266.1M against TTM revenue of 519.2M, and the 71% gross margin includes yield enhancement add-backs (small) and a plasma center gain of 8.0M in 9M. Buybacks of 180.3M and a 125M revolver draw increased debt from 72.1M to 195.9M; share count is down 6.3% but financed partly with debt. Securities class action (Mazzarino, D.N.J., lead plaintiff appointed 2026-10-16), derivative suits and three Section 220 demands are open with no accrual. The 2026 revenue floor of 530M implies Q4 revenue of at least about 150M, a step-up; guidance is a floor not a forecast. The +26% jump after results compresses the margin of safety. Peers (GRFS, CSL, Kedrion, Octapharma private) not compared and no valuation history read.
invalidation: Thesis fails if ASCENIV growth stalls or a top customer cuts volume, gross margin falls below about 65% on pricing or plasma costs, Q4 revenue misses the implied step-up for the 530M floor, inventory builds without sales, or litigation or debt-funded buybacks weaken liquidity.
